reason: B offers the clearer controlled comparison: it independently verifies SRO, controls grain size and phase state, distinguishes SRO-mediated energy-landscape effects from baseline lattice-distortion strengthening, and gives quantitative, falsifiable mechanical predictions. Its novelty is still limited and annealing/deformation may introduce confounders, but A more directly restates prior findings and incorrectly characterizes the random-solid-solution baseline as having uniform lattice strain.
